speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Our researchers' areas of expertise cover a wide range of sustainability-related fields like climate science, waste management and food safety.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The project studies ways to mitigate the Urban Heat Island effect.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Assoc Prof Winston Chow from SMU, a Singaporean expert in Urban Climatology, plays a key role as Principal Investigator.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The School also features a blend of research expertise, like Asst Prof Janice Lee, who looks into the impact of land use changes on biodiversity conservation and human livelihoods in Southeast Asia; and Prof Benjamin Horton, who is an internationally-respected expert in sea-level change.
